global: A steaming bowl of shoyu ramen boasts a rich, amber broth cradling tender noodles and a single slice of chashu. Finely sliced green onions crown the center, all served in a speckled white bowl under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle scratches with smooth, slightly reflective finish.
regions.bowl: Cream-colored ceramic bowl with subtle speckles, smooth glossy finish, and slightly raised rounded rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and clear, cradling golden noodles and a mound of sliced green onions.
